period_note: Year-end position for FY2025, sourced from the Financial Statement booklet (Adobe InDesign, same compact Consolidated & Separate Financial Statements format as FY2024's, freshly downloaded from nrbbankbd.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/, text-extracted and saved as nrbbank-financial-statement-2025.txt under annual_reports/NRBBANK/, source PDF deleted after extraction) and the Basel III Risk-Based Capital Disclosure (Microsoft Word export, saved as nrbbank-basel3-disclosure-2025.txt). No glossy 'Annual Report 2025' (Directors' Report / five-year table / photos) had been published on the bank's investor-relations page as of the FY2025 Financial Statements' own sign-off date (30 April 2026); Authorised Capital, Number of Branches/ATMs/Employees and other narrative-report-only fields are therefore gaps for FY2025 only. Both the Consolidated and Separate Balance Sheets, P&L and off-balance-sheet schedules were read directly from the source (page-image cross-checked against the text extraction to resolve the compact 8-page newspaper layout's non-linear column ordering) -- reporting basis confirmed Solo/Separate per the project's standard method (see sources.json). NPL% is calculated (classified/gross loans) for the same reason as FY2024 (label present, value cell blank in the Basel III disclosure). NOTABLE: Net Interest Income turned NEGATIVE for the first time in the bank's history (Solo: -98.84m, versus +1,165.11m in FY2024) as Interest Paid on deposits/borrowings (7,577.00m) exceeded Interest Income (7,478.15m); Profit after Tax of 108.52m is therefore driven almost entirely by Income from Investments (2,587.93m) and non-fund-based income, not core lending spread. Classified loans fell back to 6,579.98m from FY2024's 10,497.74m (a partial recovery: Additions of 1,484.99m were more than offset by Reductions of 5,402.75m per the Basel III NPA movement schedule) but NPL% (9.05% calculated) remains far above the FY2023 pre-crisis level of 4.98%. A large-loan-exposure note elsewhere in the FY2025 filing states 'Total capital of the Bank was Taka 9,094.53 million as at 31 December 2025' -- this is actually the FY2024 (not FY2025) Total Regulatory Capital figure carried over in error from the prior year's text; the FY2025 filing's own Basel III disclosure gives the correct 31 Dec 2025 Total Regulatory Capital as 10,059.86m, which is the figure used here. specific_provision_balance (1,960.83m, the Basel III disclosure's NPA-provision closing balance) covers ~29.8% of FY2025 classified loans (1,960.83/6,579.98) -- an improvement in coverage ratio from FY2024's ~20.7%, though still leaving a majority of classified exposure unprovided at the specific-provision level; see FY2024's period_note for why a blended coverage ratio is not computed.
